title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand, Solid Brass, 49-Inch, Assorted Free Standing Accessories, , Allied Brass
description:
Need towel storage without drilling? This freestanding towel stand (also called a towel rack or towel holder) adds drying space where you need it and keeps towels separated for everyday bathroom use. With four pivoting swing arms, it functions like a towel rail system that rotates out for access and swings in to save space.

Highlights:
- More drying room for shared bathrooms: 4 pivoting swing arms keep bath towels separated and easy to reach
- No wall mount required: freestanding floor stand design means no wall-mounted or wall hanging installation
- Stable placement on the floor: heavy, weighted base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Built for humid bath environments: solid brass construction resists rust and corrosion
- Designed to coordinate: part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: freestanding swing arm towel stand / towel rack / towel holder / towel rail
- Arms: 4 pivoting swing arms
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 9.25 in.
- Base: weighted (heavy base)
- Assembly: some assembly required
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
- Country of assembly: assembled in the USA
